records.canonicalQuestion: Why does hot-cache contentHash differ between WESLEY_WORK and WESLEYDESK?
alternateQuestions: Is a different routing contentHash a rollout failure?
records.shortAnswer: WESLEY_WORK L_UNAVAILABLE and WESLEYDESK L ALIGNED produce different contentHash with same merged git SHAs — not a new project.
records.detailedAnswer: Hot routing contentHash differs by host when L alignment differs

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Scout or refresh contentHash mismatch across hosts after Wave A ship
doNot: Reopen Wave A as failed solely on contentHash mismatch
Require identical bundleBytes across L_UNAVAILABLE vs ALIGNED hosts
proveBeforeClaiming: Merged Cross-Agent and AppBuilder git SHAs match
INDEX_HIT_AI_CACHE and freshnessVerdict CURRENT on each host

records.canonicalQuestion: Why did hot-cache refresh-all publish sourceCommitSha 66b974e?
alternateQuestions: What order should Cross-Agent and AppBuilder Wave A PRs merge?
records.shortAnswer: AppBuilder Wave A depends on Cross-Agent dataset registry and query-routing v1.1.0; partial main commits cause stale refresh-all SHAs.
records.detailedAnswer: Merge Cross-Agent hot-cache registry before AppBuilder consumer PR

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Hot-cache Wave rollout spans Cross-Agent registry and AppBuilder compilers
runPreflight: gh pr view Cross-Agent PR --json mergeable,state
doNot: Merge AppBuilder PR before Cross-Agent registry is on main
Run refresh-all without pulling Cross-Agent main
proveBeforeClaiming: origin/main Cross-Agent SHA matches verifiedAgainstCrossAgentSha in receipt

records.canonicalQuestion: How to prove hot-cache consumption on WESLEYDESK from WESLEY_WORK?
alternateQuestions: Which SSH user works for wesleydesk second-host gates?
records.shortAnswer: When WESLEY_WORK lacks S: cache mount, run refresh-all and scout on WESLEYDESK via cgremoteadmin@wesleydesk SSH.
records.detailedAnswer: Second-host hot-cache gate via SSH to WESLEYDESK

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Estate ship requires second-host proof but primary WSL has HOT_CACHE_ROOT_MISSING
runPreflight: test -d /mnt/s/AI Cursur Cache || ssh -i ~/.ssh/wesleydesk_cgremoteadmin cgremoteadmin@wesleydesk hostname
doNot: Fake second-host proof by setting CG_WSL_MACHINE_ROLE without correct cache root
proveBeforeClaiming: ssh gate: export CG_WSL_MACHINE_ROLE=wesleydesk; npm run hot-cache:refresh-all:json

records.canonicalQuestion: What gates are required before WAVE_A_ESTATE_SHIPPED?
alternateQuestions: Which SHAs must match for hot-cache Wave A estate rollout?
records.shortAnswer: Ship Wave A only after Cross-Agent+AppBuilder merge, republication, second-host scout PASS, and receipt commit.
records.detailedAnswer: Hot Cache Wave A estate ship three-gate closeout

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Hot Cache Wave A or estate-wide hot-routing rollout closeout
runPreflight: git pull both CapitalGlass-Cross-Agent and CG-AppBuilder-MCP
doNot: Claim WAVE_A_ESTATE_SHIPPED without second-host scout proof
Merge AppBuilder before Cross-Agent registry PR
proveBeforeClaiming: INDEX_HIT_AI_CACHE and rawScanRequired false on two hosts
